scripts.check: bun run --cwd app check && bunx biome check --write --config-path app/biome.json packages package.json
scripts.test: bun test --cwd app && bun test packages
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd app typecheck && bunx tsc --noEmit -p packages/protocol/tsconfig.json && bunx tsc --noEmit -p packages/session-client/tsconfig.json
